newsitem.title: JAPAN: Need to pave way for sustainable Japan growth - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Need to pave way for sustainable Japan growth - BOJ.

text.p: Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a parliamentary budget committee on Wednesday that it was important to lead the Japanese economy to a situation where it could achieve sustainable growth.
Matsushita was asked why the BOJ has not raised its official discount rate, now at a historic low of 0.5 percent, to help people dependent on interest rate payments.
Matsushita said the economic recovery is gradual, but there are "various" moves in the economy which are showing a firmer recovery.

"It is important to accelerate such favourable moves even without the injection of fiscal measures, and it is most important to lead the economy to a situation where it can make a sustainable recovery," he said.
"While closely monitoring economic reality, the central bank will make sure it does not make any mistakes in managing its monetary policy," he said.
Matsushita also said that capital flows in global markets depend not only on differences in interest rates, but also on market risks and the strength of each country's economy.
"I cannot detect any worrisome signs in the capital outflows (from Japan) that could become a factor to cause confusion in the financial markets," he said.
